lines: With a voice that bursts forth from my heart
A singing melody, a future turned back
And the voice that overflowed from you
Merged and resonated beneath the ultramarine sky
It's not a dream, not a dream, the footprints of tears
It's not a lie, not a lie, a smile smeared with mud
It's not a dream, not a dream, I want to shout with our arms linked
Deliver our yearning!
It doesn't have to be a miracle, it doesn't have to be beautiful
Because that thing called purpose shines brightly
An unending battery, as far as the soul can go
We just set fate ablaze and go wild
The earphones where silence lingered
A future drifting away from my own weakness
In lyrics that say “It’s okay” and “Do your best”
There were nights that made me restless
It's not a dream, not a dream, with the regret of that day
Never forget, never forget, the nail marks on my palm
It's not useless, not useless, I want to praise all of it
Just a little more
Sweating from the heat of our wishes
Carrying expectations, I stand, yet become timid from the weight
Our jersey numbers are not on our backs but answers deep in our eyes
Overlapping, illuminating each other forever
From tension, anxiety sprouts
It grips us like roots taking hold
I won’t let myself be beaten by such things
Now we set fate ablaze and go wild
Reach!
It doesn't have to be a miracle, it doesn't have to be beautiful
Because that thing called purpose shines brightly
An unending battery, as far as the soul can go
We just set fate on fire and go wild
We only raise fate and stand against it
